explanation: Two ways to carry an agent's connections to a tool running on Windows. Look at what each one has to manage; the rest of the feature (the switch, the status line, the address swap) is the same in both.

columns.title: Shared channel (now)
items: One Windows helper carries every connection
Needs its own rules: whose data goes first, slow readers, clean closing
Each review finds another hole in those rules

columns.title: One helper per connection
items: Each connection gets its own small Windows helper
The operating system handles slow readers and closing
Removes the rules that keep failing review
Each new connection waits for a helper to start (about half a second), unless the tool keeps connections open
